SeqNum.name: SeqNum
SeqNum.description: Sequence of digits without commas or decimals. Value must be positive and may not contain leading zeros.

String.name: String
String.description: Alpha-numeric free format strings, can include any character or punctuation except the delimiter. All String fields are case sensitive (i.e. morstatt != Morstatt).

Length.name: Length
Length.description: Sequence of digits without commas or decimals. Value must be positive.

Boolean.name: Boolean
Boolean.description: One of two values: 'Y' = True/Yes 'N' = False/No

UTCTimestamp.name: UTCTimestamp
UTCTimestamp.description: string field representing date and time combination Universal Time Coordinated (UTC), also known as Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). Its value space is described as the combination of date and time of day in the Chapter 5.4 of ISO 8601. Valid values are in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.s where YYYY = 0000-9999 year, MM = 01-12 month, DD = 01-31 day, HH = 00-23 hour, MM = 00-59 minute, SS = 00-60 second (60 only if UTC leap second), and optionally one or more digits representing a decimal fraction of a second. The punctuation of "-", ":" and the string value of "T" to separate the date and time are required. The "." is only required when sub-second time precision is specified. Leap Seconds: Note that UTC includes corrections for leap seconds, which are inserted to account for slowing of the rotation of the earth. Leap second insertion is declared by the International Earth Rotation Service (IERS) and has, since 1972, only occurred on the night of Dec. 31 or Jun 30. The IERS considers March 31 and September 30 as secondary dates for leap second insertion, but has never utilized these dates. During a leap second insertion, a UTCTimestamp field may read "1998-12-31T23:59:59", "1998-12-31T23:59:60", "1999-01-01T00:00:00". (see http://tycho.usno.navy.mil/leapsec.html)

data.name: data
data.description: In FIXML, all data type fields are using base64Binary encoding.

int.name: int
int.description: Sequence of digits without commas or decimals and optional sign character (characters "-" and "0" -"9"). The sign character utilizes one octet (i.e. positive int is "99999" while negative int is "-99999"). Note that int values may contain leading zeros (e.g. "00023" = "23")

NumInGroup.name: NumInGroup
NumInGroup.description: Sequence of digits without commas or decimals. Value must be positive .

char.name: char
char.description: Single character value, can include any alphanumeric character or punctuation except the delimiter. All char fields are case sensitive (i.e. m != M). By default ISO/IEC 8859-1 (Latin-1). By counterparty agreement, a different single-byte character set may be used.

7.name: BeginSeqNo
7.description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be retransmitted.

8.name: BeginString
8.description: Identifies beginning of a new FIX tagvalue encoded message. BeginString(8) contains the protocol versions for versions before FIX.4.4. FIX.4.4 and later BeginString(8) represents the FIX session profile.

9.name: BodyLength
9.description: The message length must be specified in the BodyLength(9) field. The length must be calculated by counting the number of octets in the message following the end of field delimiter (<SOH>) of BodyLength(9), up to and including the end of field delimiter (<SOH>) of the field immediately preceding the CheckSum(10) field.

10.name: CheckSum
10.description: Three-octet character representation of the modulo 256 checksum. Checksum(10) must be the last field in the message. The end of field delimiter (<SOH>) of Checksum(10) serves as the end of message delimiter.

16.name: EndSeqNo
16.description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be retransmitted. If request is for a single message, then BeginSeqNo(7) = EndSeqNo(16). If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo(16) = "0" (representing infinity).

35.name: MsgType
35.description: Defines the message type. MsgType(35) is case sensitive.

43.name: PossDupFlag
43.description: Indicates possible retransmission of the message with the sequence number in the MsgSeqNum(34) field.

49.name: SenderCompID
49.description: Assigned value used to identify peer sending message. SenderCompID(49) and TargetCompID(56) uniquely define a session.

50.name: SenderSubID
50.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.)

52.name: SendingTime
52.description: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

56.name: TargetCompID
56.description: Assigned value used to identify peer receiving the message. SenderCompID(49) and TargetCompID(56) uniquely define a session.

57.name: TargetSubID
57.description: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. "ADMIN" reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user.

58.name: Text
58.description: Free format text string often populated with error messages or warnings.

90.name: SecureDataLen
90.description: Length in octets of the SecreData(91) field.

93.name: SignatureLength
93.description: Number of octets in the Signature(89) field.

96.name: RawData
96.description: Unformatted raw data, can include bitmaps, word processor documents, etc.

97.name: PossResend
97.description: Indicates that message contain information that may have been sent earlier under another sequence number.

enumValues.name: PGP_DES_MD5
enumValues.description: PGP / DES-MD5 (See app note on FIX web site)

enumValues.name: PEM_DES_MD5
enumValues.description: PEM / DES-MD5 (see app note on FIX web site)

112.name: TestReqID
112.description: Identifier included in TestRequest(35=1) message to be returned by the peer in a Heartbeat(35=0) message as a response.

115.name: OnBehalfOfCompID
115.description: Assigned value used to identify firm originating message if the message was delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the SenderCompID(49) field and the firm originating the message in this field.

116.name: OnBehalfOfSubID
116.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

122.name: OrigSendingTime
122.description: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT") when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

123.name: GapFillFlag

enumValues.name: GAP_FILL_MESSAGE_MSG_SEQ_NUM_FIELD_VALID
enumValues.description: Gap Fill Message, MsgSeqNum(34) valid and is replacing previously transmitted message.

123.description: When set to "Y" Indicates that the SequenceReset(35=4) message is replacing session layer or application messages which will not be resent thus filling gaps in the sequence number. When set to "N" indicates that the sequence number is being reset to a new value. Any messages with MsgSeqNum(34) less than NewSeqNo(36) will not be resent.

128.name: DeliverToCompID
128.description: Assigned value used to identify the firm targeted to receive the message if the message is delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the TargetCompID (56) field and the ultimate receiver firm ID in this field.

129.name: DeliverToSubID
129.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient (i.e. trader) if the message is delivered by a third party

141.name: ResetSeqNumFlag
141.description: Indicates that both sides of the FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

142.name: SenderLocationID
142.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

143.name: TargetLocationID
143.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message destination's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

144.name: OnBehalfOfLocationID
144.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

145.name: DeliverToLocationID
145.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

212.name: XmlDataLen
212.description: Length in octets of the XmlData(213) field.

213.name: XmlData
213.description: Actual XML document (e.g. FIXML, ISO 20022, FpML).

347.name: MessageEncoding
347.description: Type of message encoding used in a message's encoded fields. MessageEncoding(347) must be specified if any fields of datatype *data* are present in the message.

355.name: EncodedText
355.description: Encoded representation of the Text(58) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field

369.name: LastMsgSeqNumProcessed
369.description: The last MsgSeqNum(34) value received by the FIX engine and processed by downstream application, such as trading engine or order routing system. Can be specified on every message sent. Useful for detecting a backlog with a counterparty.

371.name: RefTagID
371.description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced.

372.name: RefMsgType
372.description: The MsgType(35) of the FIX message being referenced.

373.name: SessionRejectReason

enumValues.name: TAG_NOT_DEFINED_FOR_THIS_MESSAGE_TYPE
enumValues.description: Tag not defined for this message type

enumValues.name: VALUE_IS_INCORRECT
enumValues.description: Value is incorrect (out of range) for this tag

enumValues.name: TAG_SPECIFIED_OUT_OF_REQUIRED_ORDER
enumValues.description: Tag specified out of required order

enumValues.name: REPEATING_GROUP_FIELDS_OUT_OF_ORDER
enumValues.description: Repeating group fields out of order

enumValues.name: INCORRECT_NUMINGROUP_COUNT_FOR_REPEATING_GROUP
enumValues.description: Incorrect NumInGroup count for repeating group

enumValues.name: NON_DATA_VALUE_INCLUDES_FIELD_DELIMITER
enumValues.description: Field value contains the field delimiter, the <SOH> character.

373.description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

383.name: MaxMessageSize
383.description: Maximum number of octets supported for a single message.

384.name: NoMsgTypes
384.description: Number of MsgTypes(35) in repeating group.

385.name: MsgDirection
385.description: Specifies the direction of the message.

464.name: TestMessageIndicator
464.description: Indicates whether or not this FIX Session is a "test" vs. "production" connection.

627.name: NoHops
627.description: Number of HopCompID(628) entries in repeating group.

628.name: HopCompID
628.description: Assigned value used to identify the third party firm which delivered a specific message either from the firm which originated the message or from another third party (if multiple "hops" are performed). It is recommended that this value be the SenderCompID(49) of the third party. Applicable when messages are communicated/re-distributed via third parties which function as service bureaus or "hubs". Only applicable if OnBehalfOfCompID(115) is being used.

629.name: HopSendingTime
629.description: Time that HopCompID(628) sent the message. It is recommended that this value be the SendingTime (52) of the message sent by the third party. Applicable when messages are communicated/re-distributed via third parties which function as service bureaus or "hubs". Only applicable if OnBehalfOfCompID(115) is being used.

630.name: HopRefID
630.description: Reference identifier assigned by HopCompID(628) associated with the message sent. It is recommended that this value be the MsgSeqNum(34) of the message sent by the third party. Applicable when messages are communicated/re-distributed via third parties which function as service bureaus or "hubs". Only applicable if OnBehalfOfCompID(115) is being used.

789.name: NextExpectedMsgSeqNum
789.description: Next expected MsgSeqNum(34) value to be received.

1129.name: CstmApplVerID
1129.description: Custom application version for a FIX service offering.

1131.name: RefCstmApplVerID
1131.description: Reference to a custom application version identifier associated with a message.

1137.name: DefaultApplVerID
1137.description: Specifies the FIX application version identifier. If DefaultApplVerID(1137) is not present, the default application level is assumed to be FIXLatest (value 10)

1156.name: ApplExtID
1156.description: The extension pack number associated with an application message.

1400.name: EncryptedPasswordMethod
1400.description: Enumeration defining the encryption method used to encrypt password fields. At this time there are no encryption methods defined by FIX within the FIX session layer.

1401.name: EncryptedPasswordLen
1401.description: Length in octets of the EncryptedPassword(1402) field.

1402.name: EncryptedPassword
1402.description: Encrypted password - encrypted via the method specified in the field EncryptedPasswordMethod(1400)

1404.name: EncryptedNewPassword
1404.description: Encrypted new password - encrypted via the method specified in the field EncryptedPasswordMethod(1400)

1406.name: RefApplExtID
1406.description: The extension pack number associated with an application message.

1407.name: DefaultApplExtID
1407.description: The extension pack number that is the default for a FIX session.

1408.name: DefaultCstmApplVerID
1408.description: The default custom application version ID that is the default for a session.

enumValues.name: NEW_SESSION_PASSWORD_DOES_NOT_COMPLY_WITH_POLICY
enumValues.description: New session password does not comply with policy

enumValues.name: LOGONS_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_AT_THIS_TIME
enumValues.description: Logons are not allowed at this time
